title: Noncommutative m5-to-Q transfer obstruction
question: Does K=A+P with A,P positive and a bounded fifth K-moment in one state imply the Q_sigma control needed by EXP-001076, or is additional noncommutative Gibbs structure necessary?

candidate_test.from_EXP_001076: For m5=1, the scalar candidate gives Q_sigma<=(3/2), hence Q_sigma^2<=9/4.
candidate_test.matrix_value: The two-sided seminorm of Q=A^(3/4) has squared value 2*Tr(rho*A^(3/2))=s.
candidate_test.violation: For (t,s)=(7,5), s=5>9/4; the violation grows along (41,29) and (239,169).
candidate_test.meaning: Form order K=A+P and a single nontracial fifth moment do not justify the scalar P/Q transfer. Additional Gibbs trace comparison, commutator control, or a stronger common-core hypothesis is required.

scope.not_closed: The witness rejects only the form-order-only scalar transfer. It is not a counterexample to the actual Q3 Gibbs family or to stronger noncommutative trace, commutator, or common-core estimates. All Q3 and QFT gates remain open.

adversarial_review.check: A and P are explicit rank-one positive matrices and K=A+P is diagonal positive.
rho is positive trace one and deliberately nontracial with respect to A; no Gibbs claim is attached to this witness.
Tr(rho*K^5)=1 is exact for every family member, while the target Q moment is computed from the exact rank-one power.
The 9/4 bound is precisely the squared EXP-001076 Q candidate at m5=1; the violation is not compared to an unrelated constant.
Pell pairs are generated inputs and the violation ratios grow exactly; no floating point threshold is used.
The matrices are an abstract form-order witness only; they are not asserted to be a canonical Q3 Hamiltonian or Gibbs state.
R259 checks the rational matrix fixtures and inequalities only; it does not formalize the actual Q3 representation.
The witness does not alter OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A, Pre-A or TECT production status.

qft_interface.closed: A finite exact obstruction shows that form order K=A+P and one nontracial K^5 moment do not by themselves instantiate EXP-001076's Q input.
qft_interface.open: Actual Q3 Gibbs trace comparison, commutator/domain control, P input, modular companion, history, direct D/delta-D Cauchy, exhaustion, Hamiltonian-to-OS identification, KMS/GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: No heat_root_incidence or canonical A1/R-192 production owner is supplied.

boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite matrix route obstruction.
next_action: Replace the failed form-order-only inference with an actual Gibbs-weighted noncommutative Holder/commutator theorem on the Q3 common core, or test that stronger theorem for an exact obstruction before instantiating P_sigma and Q_sigma.
